query:
SELECT h.number AS "hypothesis_number!", h.title AS "hypothesis_title!", t.slug AS "track_slug!", a.sequence AS "attempt_sequence!", a.state AS "state!", a.claimed_at AS "claimed_at!: _" FROM attempts a
            JOIN hypotheses h ON h.id = a.hypothesis_id
            JOIN tracks t ON t.id = a.track_id
            WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.state = ANY($2)
            ORDER BY a.claimed_at DESC, a.id DESC
            LIMIT $3
